Puzzle 787. Fibonacci as sum of two consecutive primes.

Problems & Puzzles: Puzzles

Puzzle 787. Fibonacci as sum of two consecutive primes.

Abhiram R. Devesh sent the following nice puzzle.
"Find Fibonacci numbers as sum of two consecutive prime numbers."

Abhiram sent the first four examples to OEIS as A258044

a(1) = 5 = 2 + 3 = fib(5)

a(2) = 8 = 3 + 5 = fib(6)

a(3) = 144 = 71 + 73 = fib(12)

a(4) = 1548008755920 = 774004377953 + 774004377967 = fib(60)

Carlos Rivera, found the fifth example: a(5) = 24617570215823242721662481553130368936971399966974615095762

33211000055607912198979704988704446425834042795269603588522

245550271050495783935904220352228801000 = fib(750) =

Q. Find more terms

Jan van Delden wrote on May 25, 2015

The next solution a(6)=fib(8505). The primes are fib(8505)/2 +/- 4074. Both are certified prime (primo) and have 1777 digits.

I checked n<=11000, n mod 3=0.

The values n, belonging to a(n), have the following property:

a(2),a(3): 3-smooth

a(5),a(5): 5-smooth

a(6): 7-smooth

Any reason why?

Jan van Delden
